component.name: Embr
component.summary: A native Nostr signer: your keys stay in one encrypted local process

description.p: Embr keeps your Nostr private keys in a small, encrypted, local process. Apps on this computer, and remote apps over NIP-46, ask it to sign or decrypt; you decide each request, and nothing is allowed that you did not allow.
Pre-alpha software that has not been independently audited. Do not use a key you cannot afford to lose.
